English: to give someone a hard time / to play a trick
Etymology: 골탕 (beef bone soup / figurative suffering) + 먹이다 (to feed)
Example Sentence: 물건을 비싸게 파는 한양 상인들을 골탕 먹이고 싶었어요.
Sentence Translation: He wanted to teach these merchants, who were selling things so expensively, a lesson.

English: to be dumbfounded / to be beyond belief
Etymology: 어이 (handle of a millstone) + 가 (subject marker) + 없다 (to not exist)
Example Sentence: 상인의 말에 사람들은 어이가 없다는 표정으로 말했어요.
Sentence Translation: At the merchant's words, the people spoke with a dumbfounded expression.

Example Sentence: 그 선달의 성이 김씨여서 사람들은 그를 '김선달'이라고 불렀어요.
Sentence Translation: Because his surname was Kim, people called him 'Kim Seon-dal'.

English: as much as / as many as (emphasis)
Example Sentence: 상인들은 한양에서보다 두 배나 비싼 가격에 물건을 팔았어요.
Sentence Translation: The merchants were selling goods for twice the price they cost in Hanyang.

English: as you know / don't you know?
Example Sentence: 한양에서는 동전 세 개면 살 수 있는 거잖아요!
Sentence Translation: You can buy this for three coins in Hanyang, as you know!

Example Sentence: 혹시 누가 돈을 왜 내는 거냐고 물으면 대동강 주인이 저라고 말하세요.
Sentence Translation: If anyone asks why you are paying, just tell them that I am the owner of the Daedong River.

Example Sentence: 사람들은 김선달과 약속한 대로 동전을 냈어요.
Sentence Translation: As agreed with Kim Seon-dal, the people handed him a coin.

Example Sentence: 사람들은 물을 풀 때마다 동전을 한 개씩 냈어요.
Sentence Translation: Every time they scooped water, the people handed him one coin each.

English: to do an action and take it away / continue
Example Sentence: 상인들은 사람들이 물을 사 가는 모습을 보았어요.
Sentence Translation: The merchants saw the people buying and taking the water away.

English: I recall that... / I heard that... (background)
Example Sentence: 대동강은 일 년 내내 마르지도 않는다고 하던데.
Sentence Translation: They say the Daedong River never dries up all year round (and I'm reflecting on that).

Example Sentence: 우리가 가지고 있는 돈을 합치면 될 겁니다.
Sentence Translation: It will work if we combine the money we have.

English: I'm saying it is... / it means...
Sentence Translation: I’m saying this is a river I inherited from my late parents!

Etymology: Action verb + 는 (modifier) + 척 (pretending) + 하다 (to do)
Sentence Translation: Kim Seon-dal spoke while pretending to be deeply troubled.

English: to be on the (adjective) side / relatively
Example Sentence: 이 정도면 싼 편이오. 싫으면 마시오.
Sentence Translation: At this level, it's on the cheap side. If you don't like it, forget it.

Example Sentence: 다른 사람에게 대동강을 팔까 봐 마음이 급해졌어요.
Sentence Translation: Their hearts became hurried for fear that he might sell the Daedong River to someone else.

Example Sentence: 우리는 받은 돈을 다시 돌려준 것뿐입니다.
Sentence Translation: We are only returning the money we received.
Kim Seon-dal had already fled and was gone.
Kim Seon-dal made a lot of money by selling the Daedong River.

English: it doesn't matter / to not care
Example Sentence: 가지고 있는 돈을 다 써도 상관없다고 생각했어요.
Sentence Translation: They thought it wouldn't matter even if they spent all the money they had.
